verdict.rationale: Online completion of the core registry transaction (incorporation or filing) is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, the only evidence is two probes that hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. None of the service's own published pages were retrieved, so nothing shows the transaction can be completed online. That is an absence of evidence, not a contradiction, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.
